title: 第一卷 第9章 我对你图谋不轨第一卷 第10章 你穿成这样成何体统
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
;;
沈长安和谢寒声在宗门各司其职，平日见面也只是点头打招呼，但在他印象中，二师弟性格孤僻，除了做任务就是做任务，从不和人亲近。
他总觉得出去一趟，小师妹和二师弟的关系不一样了。
按理来说，宗门和睦是他愿意看见的，可不知为何，他心头说不出的诡异。
他欲言又止，想问清楚他们之间到底是什么关系。
又觉得没必要。
还能是什么关系。
可能对于小师妹来说，比起自己，更亲近那位二师兄罢了。
男人垂下眸子，眼底浅色的涟漪流转，温声细语：“好，如果谢师弟同意的话。”
就算小师妹愿意亲近，也不见得谢寒声同意。
“不知谢师弟可愿意？”
他侧过身，对身后之人笑容浅淡。
早在谢寒声刚刚靠近的时候，他就察觉到了谢寒声的气息。
谢寒声黑袍包裹着健壮的身躯，剑不离身，抱在怀里。
此人一举一动都像是程序设定好的机器，听到方才的对话，情绪也淡淡的，深沉好看的黑眸定定落在舒晩昭身上，在她的脸上停顿几秒。
舒晩昭摸了摸脸，歪头看他，露出一口小白牙，“二师兄怎么不说话？”
三个人伫立在院子中，鸟儿扑腾着翅膀经过，都被莫名其妙的气氛惊了一下，翅膀狂扇，呲溜一下消失在半空，徒留一根羽毛落在地上，轻轻地，打破空气中的寂静。
“可以。”沉闷的嗓音犹如被打了杆子的闷葫芦，空空闷闷的，像是从胸腔发出来的。
舒晩昭满意了。
沈长安却十分诧异。

但他没再多言，袖中的两样物品微微攥紧，犹豫再三，还是赠与了她。
“师妹，你经脉被魔气侵蚀过，魔气不比其他，一旦被缠上难以根除，这些时日记得服用驱魔丹，并保持心平气和，以免受魔气影响产生心魔。”
他拿出两样东西，一个是青色瓷瓶，另一个是白玉匣子，点缀着精致的金色纹路，阳光下流光溢彩，很是好看，“此物是雪凝丸，当是师兄错怪你的赔礼，你且收着，可解毒，也可清心凝神。”
男人恪守规矩，错了就是错了，拿出手的东西也都是丹药方面的。
在男人拿出丹药的那一刻，系统开始运转。
【叮——恭喜宿主获得男主沈长安送的关键道具，雪凝丸，材料稀缺，整个宗门只有一枚，可解除一系列负面效果。】
【雪凝丸！这可是剧情后期才出现的关键道具，也正是因为有雪凝丸，谢寒声才能在宗门坚持那么久，如果没有这枚丹药，他一定比原剧情中更早入魔。】
【宿主，有用，绝对不能让这枚丹药落入谢寒声手中。】
舒晩昭微微一愣，这么重要的东西，竟然这么轻松就给她了？
她连同驱魔丹一起收好。
生怕晚了被那边的谢寒声抢了去。
沈长安手里的丹药几乎是撒手没。
他哑然失笑，小师妹这是……怎么跟猫抢食物似的。
“罢了，今天你炸了自己的房子，我便不罚你了，但要自己补好，不许挪用宗门财务。”
舒晩昭：“！”
她不可思议，大师兄这么抠门的吗？
沈长安交代好一切，又有小弟子来找他，他没做停留，离开时与谢寒声擦肩而过。
他微微颔首，算是打招呼了。
还叮嘱了一句：“别惯着她。”
content_en:
;;
Shen Chang'an and Xie Hansheng each performed their own duties in the sect, and they would only nod and say hello when they met on weekdays. However, in his impression, the second junior brother was withdrawn and never got close to others except when doing tasks.
He always felt that after going out, the relationship between the junior sister and the second junior brother would be different.
Logically speaking, harmony among the sects is what he wants to see, but for some reason, he feels strange in his heart.
He hesitated to speak, wanting to know what the relationship between them was.
I don’t think it’s necessary anymore.
What else could it be?
Maybe for the little junior sister, she is closer to the second senior brother than to herself.
The man lowered his eyes, with light ripples under his eyes, and whispered softly: "Okay, if Junior Brother Xie agrees."
Even if the junior sister is willing to get close, Xie Hansheng may not agree.
"I wonder if you would be willing to thank me, junior brother?"
He turned sideways and smiled lightly at the person behind him.
As early as when Xie Hansheng approached, he noticed Xie Hansheng's aura.
Xie Hansheng's black robe wrapped his strong body, and his sword never left his body, holding it in his arms.
Every move of this person was like a programmed machine. Hearing the conversation just now, his mood was light. His deep and beautiful black eyes were fixed on Shu Mingzhao and paused on her face for a few seconds.
Shu Mingzhao touched his face, tilted his head to look at him, showing his small white teeth, "Second Senior Brother, why don't you speak?"
The three people stood in the yard, and the birds fluttered their wings as they passed by. They were all startled by the inexplicable atmosphere. Their wings flapped wildly and disappeared in the air, leaving only one feather falling to the ground, gently breaking the silence in the air.
"Okay." The dull voice was like a dull gourd that had been hit with a pole, empty and dull, as if coming from the chest.
Shu Mingzhao was satisfied.
Shen Changan was very surprised.
But he didn't say anything more. He clenched the two items in his sleeves slightly, and after much hesitation, he gave them to her.
"Junior sister, your meridians have been eroded by demonic energy. Demonic energy is no better than others. Once entangled, it is difficult to eradicate. Remember to take exorcism pills during these times and keep calm to avoid being affected by evil energy and creating inner demons."
He took out two things, one was a cyan porcelain bottle and the other was a white jade box, dotted with delicate golden lines, which shone brightly in the sunlight and looked very beautiful. "This is Xuening Pill. I think it is an apology from my senior brother for wrongly blaming you. Keep it. It can detoxify and clear your mind."
Men abide by the rules, and if they make a mistake, they are wrong, and the things they take out are all related to elixirs.
The moment the man took out the elixir, the system began to operate.
[Ding—Congratulations to the host for obtaining the key item from the male protagonist Shen Changan, Xuening Pill. The material is scarce and there is only one in the entire sect. It can relieve a series of negative effects. 】
【Xue Ning Wan! This is a key prop that only appears in the later stages of the plot. It is precisely because of the Xuening Pill that Xie Hansheng was able to persist in the sect for so long. Without this pill, he would have become possessed earlier than in the original plot. 】
[Host, it’s useful. You must not let this elixir fall into Xie Hansheng’s hands. 】
Shu Mingzhao was slightly stunned. How could such an important thing be given to her so easily?
She put it away together with the exorcism pill.
I'm afraid I'll be snatched away by Xie Hansheng over there if it's too late.
The pill in Shen Changan's hand was almost gone.
He couldn't help but laugh. This little junior sister was... like a cat grabbing food.
"That's all, if you blow up your own house today, I won't punish you, but you have to make up for it yourself and don't embezzle the sect's finances."
Shu Mingzhao: "!"
She couldn't believe it. Is the eldest brother so stingy?
After Shen Changan explained everything, another young disciple came to see him. He did not stop and passed by Xie Hansheng when he left.
He nodded slightly as a greeting.
He also warned: "Don't spoil her."
